ai.title: Elephant’s memory: MIT built a robot that could remember exactly where you left your household items
ai.description: MIT's new DAAAM robot memory system marks a major advance in artificial intelligence. Unlike traditional robots, it remembers objects with their location and time. Powered by AI and spatial memory, it answers natural questions in seconds. The breakthrough could improve robots in homes, factories, hospitals, and warehouses, bringing machines closer to human-like memory and real-world assistance.
ai.title_cn: 大象的记忆：麻省理工学院建造了一个机器人，可以准确记住你把家居用品放在哪里
ai.description_cn: 麻省理工学院的新DAAAM机器人记忆系统标志着人工智能的重大进步。与传统机器人不同的是，它通过位置和时间记住物体。它由人工智能和空间记忆提供支持，可以在几秒钟内回答自然问题。这一突破可以改善家庭、工厂、医院和仓库中的机器人，使机器更接近人类记忆和现实世界的协助。
